key.name: menubar-enabled
key.summary: Turn the top bar into a macOS menu bar

key.name: hide-distro-menu-button
key.summary: Hide the distribution's menu button (such as Zorin Menu) from the top bar
key.description: The Super key keeps opening it.

key.name: menubar-app-menus
key.summary: Show the focused app's own menus in the menu bar
key.description: File, Edit, View and the rest, for apps that share their menus (GTK apps with a menu bar, LibreOffice).

key.name: menubar-status-menus
key.summary: Show Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and battery as menu bar icons of their own
key.description: Each opens its own menu, as on macOS, instead of sitting in quick settings.

key.name: menubar-all-monitors
key.summary: Show the menu bar on every monitor
key.description: Off shows it on the primary monitor only.

key.name: dock-enabled
key.summary: Show the macOS dock
key.description: Replaces the overview's dash. Turn off Dash to Dock while it is on.

key.name: dock-all-monitors
key.summary: Show the dock on every monitor
key.description: Off shows it on the primary monitor only.

key.name: dock-position
key.summary: Where the dock sits on the screen
key.description: Along the bottom, or down the left or right side.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.summary: Size of the dock's icons, in pixels

key.name: dock-autohide
key.summary: Hide the dock when a window covers it
key.description: Move the pointer to the screen edge the dock sits on to bring it back.

key.name: dock-magnification
key.summary: Magnify dock icons under the pointer

key.name: dock-minimize-to-app
key.summary: Minimize windows into their app's icon
key.description: Off shows each minimized window as a thumbnail before the Trash, as macOS does by default.

key.name: dock-bounce
key.summary: Bounce dock icons
key.description: An app's icon bounces while it opens and when it asks for attention.

key.name: dock-genie
key.summary: Minimize windows into the dock with the genie effect
key.description: Replaces GNOME's minimize animation. Turn off Magic Lamp while it is on.

key.name: launchpad-enabled
key.summary: Show Launchpad from the dock's Apps icon
key.description: A full-screen grid of every app.

key.name: launchpad-super-key
key.summary: The Super key opens Launchpad
key.description: Instead of the overview or the distribution's app menu.

key.name: spotlight-enabled
key.summary: Search apps, files and settings with Spotlight

key.name: spotlight-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens Spotlight

key.name: spotlight-online
key.summary: Spotlight looks up exchange rates, definitions and web suggestions online
key.description: What is typed goes to Frankfurter (exchange rates), the Free Dictionary API (single words) and Google (suggestions).

key.name: control-center-enabled
key.summary: Show quick settings as the macOS Control Center
key.description: Toggles first, then titled sliders, a Focus toggle and Macr's look.

key.name: app-icon-tiles
key.summary: Give app icons the icon theme lacks a macOS tile
key.description: The original icon on a light macOS squircle, in the dock, Launchpad, Spotlight and the app switcher.

key.name: osd-enabled
key.summary: Show volume and brightness as a macOS pill
key.description: GNOME's on-screen display moves under the menu bar at the top right, as a small frosted pill.

key.name: switcher-enabled
key.summary: Show Alt+Tab as the macOS app switcher
key.description: A frosted panel with big icons, a soft highlight and the chosen app's name. Alt+Tab keeps working as before.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.summary: Show notifications the macOS way
key.description: Banners as frosted cards at the top right, and the clock's calendar and notification list as the macOS Notification Center.

key.name: mission-control-enabled
key.summary: Show the overview as macOS Mission Control
key.description: Windows spread over the dimmed wallpaper, with the Spaces bar always at the top.

key.name: stage-manager-enabled
key.summary: Use macOS Stage Manager
key.description: The focused app stays in the middle of the primary monitor and the other apps' windows wait as stages in a strip on the left; clicking a stage swaps it in.

key.name: gestures-enabled
key.summary: Four-finger touchpad gestures
key.description: Pinch with four fingers for Launchpad, spread them to show the desktop, swipe down for App Exposé.

key.name: shake-to-find-enabled
key.summary: Shake the pointer to find it
key.description: A quick wiggle of the mouse or touchpad makes the pointer three times as big for a moment.

key.name: wallpaper-click-enabled
key.summary: Click the wallpaper to reveal the desktop
key.description: A click on the wallpaper slides the windows aside; another click brings them back. Off by default: with desktop icons, clicking an icon counts too.

key.name: hot-corners-enabled
key.summary: Use macOS hot corners
key.description: Each screen corner can open Mission Control, Launchpad, the desktop or the Notification Center, or lock the screen. Takes over GNOME's own hot corner.

key.name: hot-corner-top-left
key.summary: What the top left corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: hot-corner-top-right
key.summary: What the top right corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: hot-corner-bottom-left
key.summary: What the bottom left corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: hot-corner-bottom-right
key.summary: What the bottom right corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: lock-screen-enabled
key.summary: macOS lock screen
key.description: The date and a big time at the top of the lock screen, the user's avatar and name low in the middle with the password field under them, over the wallpaper unblurred.

key.name: login-screen-enabled
key.summary: macOS login screen
key.description: Read by the copy of Macr installed for GDM (scripts/login-screen.sh): the login screen gets the lock screen's look, a big time at the top and the users low in the middle.

key.name: traffic-lights-enabled
key.summary: macOS traffic lights on windows
key.description: Close, minimize and maximize first on the left of app windows, drawn as the macOS red, yellow and green lights in GTK, libadwaita and X11 apps.

key.name: traffic-lights-saved-layout
key.summary: Window button layout before Macr's traffic lights
key.description: Put back when the traffic lights are turned off; empty when Macr did not change it.

key.name: window-corners-enabled
key.summary: Round window corners the macOS way
key.description: Windows that do not round their own corners (Qt, Electron, X11 apps) get rounded corners, and frameless ones a shadow.

key.name: window-corner-radius
key.summary: Window corner radius
key.description: In pixels.

key.name: tiling-enabled
key.summary: Tile windows the macOS way
key.description: Drag a window to the left or right edge of the screen for a half, to a corner for a quarter or to the top to fill the screen, or use Super+Ctrl with the arrow keys. Turns off GNOME's own edge tiling while it is on. Turn off Tiling Shell and Tiling Assistant while it is on.

key.name: tiling-margins
key.summary: Tiled windows have margins
key.description: A small gap around tiled windows and between them.

key.name: tiling-saved-edge-tiling
key.summary: GNOME's edge tiling was on before Macr's tiling
key.description: Turned back on when Macr's tiling is turned off.

key.name: tiling-saved-toggle-tiled
key.summary: GNOME's half-tiling shortcuts before Macr's tiling
key.description: Macr takes its own shortcuts out of org.gnome.mutter.keybindings toggle-tiled-left and toggle-tiled-right while tiling is on, and puts these lists back when it is turned off.

key.name: tiling-left
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the left half

key.name: tiling-right
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the right half

key.name: tiling-top
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the top half

key.name: tiling-bottom
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the bottom half

key.name: tiling-top-left
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the top left quarter

key.name: tiling-top-right
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the top right quarter

key.name: tiling-bottom-left
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the bottom left quarter

key.name: tiling-bottom-right
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window to the bottom right quarter

key.name: tiling-fill
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that makes the focused window fill the screen

key.name: tiling-center
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that centres the focused window

key.name: tiling-return
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that gives the focused window back the size it had before it was tiled

key.name: tiling-arrange-left-right
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window left and the previous window right

key.name: tiling-arrange-right-left
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window right and the previous window left

key.name: tiling-arrange-top-bottom
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window at the top and the previous window at the bottom

key.name: tiling-arrange-bottom-top
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that tiles the focused window at the bottom and the previous window at the top

key.name: screenshot-enabled
key.summary: Take screenshots the macOS way
key.description: Super+Shift+3 takes the whole screen at once, Super+Shift+4 a dragged area or a window, and Super+Shift+5 shows the screenshot toolbar, which Print shows too. GNOME saves and copies each screenshot as usual, and Print, Shift+Print and Alt+Print keep working.

key.name: screenshot-screen-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that takes a screenshot of the whole screen

key.name: screenshot-area-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that takes a screenshot of a dragged area
key.description: Drag over the screen with the crosshair; Space switches to picking a window and back.

key.name: screenshot-toolbar-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that shows the screenshot toolbar

key.name: screenshot-thumbnail
key.summary: Show a floating thumbnail after each screenshot
key.description: A small copy of the screenshot at the bottom right for a few seconds, instead of GNOME's notification banner. Click it to open the picture, swipe it right to put it away, or right-click it to copy, show or delete the file.

key.name: emoji-picker-enabled
key.summary: Emoji & Symbols picker
key.description: Its shortcut opens a macOS emoji picker that types the emoji into the app you are in.

key.name: emoji-picker-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the emoji picker

key.name: emoji-recent
key.summary: The emoji picked last, newest first, for Frequently Used

key.name: clipboard-history-enabled
key.summary: Clipboard history
key.description: What you copy (text and images) is kept in memory for eight hours and never written to disk; its shortcut opens it to paste something again. Copies a password manager marks as secret are not kept.

key.name: clipboard-history-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the clipboard history

key.name: keyboard-enabled
key.summary: Mac keyboard shortcuts
key.description: Super stands in for the Command key: Super+Q quits the app, Super+M minimizes the window, Super+H hides the app and Super+Alt+H hides the others. GNOME's own Super+H and Super+M give way while it is on.

key.name: keyboard-quit
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that quits the focused app

key.name: keyboard-minimize
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that minimizes the focused window

key.name: keyboard-hide
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that hides the focused app

key.name: keyboard-hide-others
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that hides every app but the focused one

key.name: keyboard-saved-wm
key.summary: GNOME's window shortcuts before Macr's keyboard shortcuts
key.description: Macr takes its own shortcuts out of org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings minimize while its keyboard shortcuts are on, and puts this list back when they are turned off.

key.name: keyboard-saved-shell
key.summary: GNOME's shell shortcuts before Macr's keyboard shortcuts
key.description: Macr takes its own shortcuts out of org.gnome.shell.keybindings toggle-message-tray while its keyboard shortcuts are on, and puts this list back when they are turned off.

key.name: app-expose-enabled
key.summary: App Exposé
key.description: All of one app's windows on the current workspace at a glance, from Show All Windows in the dock icon's menu or the keyboard shortcut.

key.name: app-expose-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that shows all windows of the focused app

key.name: app-expose-saved-wm
key.summary: GNOME's unmaximize shortcut before App Exposé
key.description: Macr takes its App Exposé shortcut out of org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings unmaximize while App Exposé is on, and puts this list back when it is turned off.

key.name: fullscreen-spaces-enabled
key.summary: Full-screen apps get their own Space
key.description: A window that goes full screen moves to a new workspace next to its own, and goes back when it leaves full screen. Only with dynamic workspaces.

key.name: dock-downloads
key.summary: Downloads stack in the dock
key.description: The Downloads folder before the Trash; click it to see the newest downloads.

key.name: dock-downloads-view
key.summary: How the Downloads stack opens
key.description: Automatic fans out a few items and shows more as a grid.

key.name: accent-enabled
key.summary: Accent colour
key.description: Lets Macr re-colour its menus, dialogs and Control Center with the chosen accent. No switch in the settings window: the accent is blue when off.

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Accent colour
key.description: The colour of highlighted menu items, default buttons and active toggles in Macr; wallpaper picks the macOS accent nearest the desktop picture's colours.

key.name: dynamic-desktop-enabled
key.summary: Dynamic desktop
key.description: The desktop picture follows the time of day: warm at sunrise and sunset, dimmer and cooler at night.

key.name: appearance-auto
key.summary: Auto appearance
key.description: Light from sunrise to sunset and dark at night, as macOS's Auto appearance; the GTK and shell themes follow when they have a light and a dark variant.

key.name: appearance-auto-phase
key.summary: Last day or night Auto appearance applied
key.description: Kept by Macr, so a change made by hand holds until the next sunrise or sunset.

key.name: dock-stacks
key.summary: Folder stacks in the dock
key.description: Paths of folders shown as stacks before the Downloads stack.

key.name: dock-recent-apps
key.summary: Recent apps in the dock
key.description: The last three apps you quit that are not kept in the dock stay after the running apps.

key.name: dock-recent-apps-list
key.summary: The recent apps
key.description: Kept by Macr: desktop file ids of the apps last quit, newest first.

key.name: desktop-widgets-enabled
key.summary: Widgets on the desktop
key.description: Clock, calendar, weather, batteries and photo widgets on the desktop, under your windows.

key.name: desktop-widgets
key.summary: The widgets on the desktop
key.description: Which widgets show, in order: clock, calendar, weather, batteries, photos.

key.name: desktop-widget-sizes
key.summary: Each widget's size
key.description: small or medium for each widget that has a medium size; widgets not listed are small.

key.name: desktop-widget-positions
key.summary: Where each widget was dragged
key.description: Each widget's top left corner as fractions of the primary monitor's work area; widgets not listed take their default place.
